_comment: Resist! Civilian cards. 8 total. Each shows a civilian count; when drawn (e.g. via a Mission/Enemy effect) it goes face-up to the Graveyard. Reaching 5+ total civilians in the Graveyard loses the game. The special '0 Civilians' card is shuffled back in and NOT replaced when drawn. Transcribed from Civilian Cards.jpg.

cards.effect: When you draw this card, immediately shuffle it back into the Civilian deck. Do not draw another card to replace it.
